items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Every candidate seat of distinction — predicates, objecthood, conceded difference, free-standing being, function — collapses into knower-dependence; the opponent's no-difference is granted, then outflanked from inside (vv1-8). [1] Grasping-less awareness is declared inert, and the proof turns: only self-reflective consciousness can stand as ground (v9).

paragraphs.text: Imagine someone says: nothing is really different from anything else — not real from unreal, not awake from inert. The proof starts by saying: fine, granted. Then it walks through every place you might still hide a difference — in words, in objects, in deals you make, in bare existence, in getting-things-done — and shows each one leaning on a knower to mean anything.

Then comes the sting in the tail. If even bare awareness — just shining, without grasping anything — is allowed, it turns out to be exactly as dead as a stone. So the only thing that can stand as the ground of everything is awareness that actively knows itself.

items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] What never stood cannot stand another: consciousness fits itself to this and I, orders inert selves by double certainty, and completes severed grasping in self-rest (vv10-15). [1] The same self twofold — breath-bound atom, unbroken whole — gathers in one continuous end-ground where nothing shows more inert than shining (vv16-18).

paragraphs.text: Something that never stood up on its own cannot prop anything else up. So the question becomes: how does awareness manage to be the ground? Answer: it fits itself to both sides at once — it says this when it shows you the world, and it says I when it rests in itself.
It also settles the inert stuff in order — by a double rule of excluding and including — and finishes every broken-off grasping by coming home to rest in its own shape.

And here is the strangest part: the very same self is two things at once — tiny as an atom when measured by breath, and whole without any break as the supreme self. Both are gathered into one continuous ground, where nothing looks more dead than shining does alive.

items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22). [1] Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).

paragraphs.text: Breath, body, and the whole eightfold contraption get demoted: they are things to be known, not knowers. No ordering power lives in breath. No restraint can touch the self. Being alive stands beyond anything that fails to show up.

Then rest itself starts to unfold: first freedom, then the power to do, then full lordship. Illusion gets its name from power alone — no second cause needed. The mother-principle of all awarenesses is proclaimed, beginningless. Only those who share in I get pervasion and linking.
And the final verdict on the world: difference keeps shining, and recognition says it was non-dual all along.
